incident.incident_description: User observed an interactive Windows 11 Notepad modal dialog referencing a deleted temporary file (user_unrelated_doc_1791471309.txt) on their desktop.

causal_chain: 1. In scripts/test_f0_15_desktop_lifecycle.py, test_3_mixed_ownership created user_file = tmp_dir / f'user_unrelated_doc_{int(time.time())}.txt' to simulate pre-existing ambient user document state.
2. The test launched a mock user Notepad instance via _launch_win32_process('notepad.exe "{user_file}"').
3. In Windows 11, Notepad (Microsoft.WindowsNotepad) is a packaged application with multi-tab support and background tab routing.
4. At step 7 of the test, teardown attempted to close the mock user Notepad by searching for an element named 'Close' via UI Automation (inspect_window_ui) and invoking it.
5. When multiple tabs or complex UI structures exist, clicking 'Close' on a UI element either closed an individual tab without terminating the host process or failed to focus the intended window.

6. Immediately following, the test script executed user_file.unlink() in a try-except block while the Notepad process was still alive and maintaining an open file handle/reference to user_unrelated_doc_1791471309.txt.
7. Windows 11 Notepad detected that its open backing file was removed from disk, triggering a persistent modal prompt on the user desktop asking whether the user wanted to save changes.
8. Furthermore, teardown was not wrapped in a try...finally block; any assertion failure prior to line 352 completely bypassed cleanup.

changes: Wrapped test_2, test_3, and test_4 in try...finally blocks.
In test_3 finally block, captured user_pid is deterministically terminated using psutil.Process(user_pid).terminate() with fallback psutil.Process(user_pid).kill(), followed by process wait.
Unlinking of temporary test files (user_file, astra_file) is strictly deferred until the process is confirmed dead.
In test_2 and test_4, identical try...finally blocks guarantee process termination prior to any file unlinking.

rules: Astra closes ONLY resources where astra_created == 1 and user_interacted == 0 and lifecycle_state != USER_TAKEOVER_DETACHED.
PID reuse protection validates process_creation_time before any termination call.
SAVE_BEFORE_CLOSE requires artifact existence on disk before releasing window.
Never kill arbitrary processes by executable name.
